Connecting…

Waits at least 400 ms and requires 250 ms of low rotation after a stroke. Very fast consecutive strokes may be skipped.

Ready?

Enable motion, hold still to calibrate, then record.

Early mode trades accuracy for a faster response. Detector idle Waiting for gyro readings Keep the page visible. Grip securely, use a wrist strap, and keep your swing area clear. This animates a preset stroke, not your exact 3D motion.
Detection diagnostics

If a stroke is missed, tap Stop and download the trace. It includes recent corrected gyro readings, recovery states, predictions, and the hand/mode used. New sessions replace the trace.

Test the connection without sensors

Open the game in the same room. Test buttons work on your Mac too.
